inlines.v: TOP'PED TOP'PING, participle present tense Covering the top; capping; surpassing; cropping; lopping. 1. adjective Fine; gallant. [But Johnson's definition is probably incorrect.] 2. Proud; assuming superiority. [This is the sense in which the common people of noun England use the word, and I believe the true sense, but it is not elegant.] TOP'PING, noun In seamen's language, the act of pulling one extremity of a yard higher than the other.
